productionOnly.schemaIntent: Legacy place-search response backed by production repositories and discovery providers.
productionOnly.reason: The memory composition currently exposes deterministic layer and discover fixtures instead of the legacy aggregate search.
productionOnly.target: Move search behind a repository/provider adapter during shared createApp extraction.

productionOnly.reason: Memory data has no representative aggregate statistics; fabricating rankings would make behavioral assertions misleading.
productionOnly.target: Add a TagRepository fixture adapter when this route moves into shared registration.

productionOnly.schemaIntent: Cached historical radar tile bytes for a timestamp and tile coordinate.
productionOnly.reason: The memory composition has no historical tile archive; its current weather endpoints are synthetic or return no tile.
productionOnly.target: Keep absent until a small deterministic recorded or synthetic radar fixture is added.

productionOnly.reason: Memory exercises Wikipedia through the provider/layer contracts and intentionally does not duplicate the legacy convenience endpoint.
productionOnly.target: Retire the legacy endpoint or register it through the shared Wikipedia fixture adapter.

productionOnly.schemaIntent: Validated staking mutation with persisted balance and position effects.
productionOnly.reason: A synthetic server must not present an in-memory monetary mutation as equivalent to production staking semantics.
productionOnly.target: Add only with an explicitly fake ledger adapter and contract tests.

productionOnly.schemaIntent: Validated unstaking mutation with persisted balance and position effects.
productionOnly.reason: A synthetic server must not present an in-memory monetary mutation as equivalent to production staking semantics.
productionOnly.target: Add only with an explicitly fake ledger adapter and contract tests.

productionOnly.schemaIntent: Live aircraft positions for a viewport, proxied and cached from ADSB.lol (ODbL 1.0) with each feature carrying its source and position age.
productionOnly.reason: Live upstream sources are registered in the production composition only; the memory server serves deterministic fixtures and has no upstream network access.
productionOnly.target: Keep the adapter behind the same FeatureProvider boundary if the memory server ever needs fixtures.

productionOnly.schemaIntent: Live vessel positions for a viewport: AISstream when a key is configured, keyless Digitraffic for Finnish waters otherwise, with per-feature source attribution.
productionOnly.reason: Same as live aircraft: no upstream in the memory composition, and the collector is a server-side WebSocket that only exists in production.
productionOnly.target: Add deterministic fixtures before the memory server advertises the layer.

productionOnly.schemaIntent: Operational status of the live traffic sources (collector configured/connected, tracked vessel count) without exposing provider keys.
productionOnly.reason: The diagnostic exists for the production collector; the memory composition has no collector to report.
productionOnly.target: Move under the operations surface if more live sources appear.

memoryOnly.schemaIntent: Legacy E2E alias returning a deterministic feature collection.
memoryOnly.reason: Older browser tests used a dedicated Park4Night path while production resolves the same layer through /layers/:layerId/features.
memoryOnly.target: Remove after every consumer uses the generic layer endpoint.

memoryOnly.schemaIntent: Offline fixture returning deterministic MeshCore nodes inside the requested bbox.
memoryOnly.reason: The MeshCore data layer is a server adapter; offline runs must not contact the analyzer, while production resolves it through /layers/:layerId/features.
memoryOnly.target: Serve the same fixture through the generic layer endpoint once the offline registry carries it.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: The shared authenticated route sends only an explicitly consented, bounded projection of the caller's PlanDocument to the configured external AI gateway; owner identity, notes, conversations, annotations and arbitrary metadata are excluded.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same route, consent and ownership contract returns a deterministic labelled offline answer without contacting an external model.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: AI route, plan-projection and browser tests cover explicit consent, owner isolation, private no-store responses, excluded fields and no automatic PlanDocument revision change; route parity proves the method/path is shared.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: Both endpoints are hidden as 404 without the server-only operations bearer token. Authenticated responses expose redacted OpenMetrics and a bounded provider/circuit status view without request URLs, query values, prompts, email, wallet or coordinates.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same registrar and hidden-by-default behavior are used; test composition can inject a token and exercise deterministic in-process telemetry without an external backend.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Operational route, telemetry, correlation and privacy tests cover authentication, no-store headers, bounded status records and forbidden sensitive labels; route parity proves both paths are shared.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: The shared provider-neutral service uses durable PostgreSQL orders, subscriptions, entitlements, referrals, tips, verified payment events and an immutable ledger. No live provider or catalog seed is enabled.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same registrar uses process-local atomic storage and a visibly labelled synthetic catalog fixture. Checkout remains disabled unless the explicit non-production synthetic HMAC adapter is configured.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Commerce SDK, migration, state-machine, resolver and shared-route tests cover locked metadata, server-side denial-before-fetch, signed webhook idempotency, refund/cancel/expiry and providerless behavior; route parity proves all seven paths are shared.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: The shared registrar uses a durable transactional repository. Declarative HTTP remains fail-closed until exact public hosts are reviewed in the server registry.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same contracts use an atomic process-local repository; the declarative source registry is empty so fixture/offline execution cannot contact the network.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: SDK contract/import suites, SSRF boundary tests, atomic route tests and route parity cover the public extension boundary.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: Configured capabilities are combined with active database/upstream readiness.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: Normal memory mode reports configured-only readiness; offline mode forces every keyed capability off and identifies fixtureMode=offline.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: The offline smoke asserts fixtureMode and the route-parity test keeps the path shared.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: Registry-backed providers can query databases and public upstreams.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: Only deterministic OSM/user fixtures and the earthquake v2 fixture are implemented; unsupported providers return 404.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Layer/provider unit tests own payload compatibility; route parity owns method/path presence.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: Provider routing, optional waypoints, restrictions and fallback behavior.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: Synthetic straight-line calculations; offline mode also replaces the legacy GET route so OSRM is never contacted.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Planning E2E checks response UX; offline network guard proves no provider call escapes.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: Shared v2 contracts use owner-scoped PostgreSQL persistence and live adjacent routing providers.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same registrar uses an owner-scoped in-memory repository and deterministic two-endpoint segment routing without fetch.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Shared route tests cover auth, revisions, partial failures and exports; route parity proves identical registration.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: The shared event registrar uses PostgreSQL and refreshes from Ticketmaster only when its official adapter is explicitly configured.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same registrar uses labelled synthetic fixtures and no upstream adapters, including in offline mode.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Event service and route tests own filtering, pagination and contract behavior; route parity proves all four paths are shared.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: The shared registrar uses durable linked-identity, nonce and audit tables; SIWE is disabled unless its public origin is explicitly configured, and live Aavegotchi inventory fails closed behind its current official-indexer gate.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same registrar uses a process-local repository, local EIP-191 verification and an explicitly labeled simulation inventory fixture.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Identity route/service tests cover origin and session binding, exact-message verification, nonce replay, global wallet uniqueness, revocation, simulation labels and inventory gating; route parity proves all six paths are shared.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: ACL-aware source resolution plus canonical enrichment.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: Echoes validated coordinate/source hints so the detail UI can render without provider or database access.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Production ACL is unit-tested separately; route parity owns the shared public route shape.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: The shared authenticated service uses the owner-scoped PostgreSQL repository.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: The same route registrar and domain service use a process-local owner-scoped repository.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Shared route contract tests cover validation, ACL, round trips, filters and cursors; route parity proves both compositions register every endpoint.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: Persistent repositories, production validation and world state.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: Process-local repositories and deterministic world fixtures with the same client-facing route intent.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: Domain and E2E tests cover representative contracts; extraction to shared route modules remains planned.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.production: Shared provider routes retain live/cached upstream behavior.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.memory: Normal memory mode retains the shared behavior; explicit offline mode registers recorded/synthetic replacements and blocks any unlisted outbound fetch.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.verification: offlineFixtureRoutes tests validate deterministic responses and offline-smoke blocks unexpected browser traffic.

sharedCreateAppPlan.goal: One route-registration graph with injected production or memory repositories/providers.
steps: Extract auth, user content, planning, social and game route registrars without changing their handlers.
Define repository/provider ports at the composition boundary and supply production and memory adapters.
Build createApp(dependencies) from the shared registrars, leaving only startup and adapter construction in each entrypoint.
Reduce this divergence list as legacy routes are retired or fixtures become contract-faithful.
sharedCreateAppPlan.exitCriterion: Only explicitly fixture-inappropriate routes remain different, and every remaining entry has auth/schema intent plus a tested reason.
